transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?
I'm here because I've been having terrible trouble sleeping for the past three weeks. I just feel constantly stressed and on edge, and I really need some help getting some rest.
I'm sorry to hear you've been feeling this way. Did something specific or highly stressful happen about three weeks ago when these sleep problems and feelings of being on edge started?

Yes, these sleep issues and feelings of being on edge definitely started right around three weeks ago. However, I'm really not sure what caused it, and I can't pinpoint any specific stressful event that might have triggered all of this.
Along with the sleep issues and feeling on edge, have you also been feeling down, sad, or losing interest in the things you normally enjoy?

No, I haven't really been feeling sad or losing interest in my hobbies. My main struggle is this constant state of alertness and feeling so on edge, which is completely ruining my sleep. It feels like my body is stuck on high alert rather than me feeling depressed.
Have you ever had periods lasting several days where you felt unusually energized, active, or felt like you didn't need much sleep to feel fully rested?

No, I have never experienced periods where I felt unusually energized or needed less sleep. It is actually the exact opposite—I feel completely exhausted all the time because my sleep has been so terrible.
Have you noticed yourself frequently worrying about various everyday things for a much longer time, perhaps for six months or more, or is this anxiety completely new to you?
No, this anxiety and tension are completely new to me. I've never felt like this before, and it has only been happening for about three weeks now rather than six months.
Have you recently started any new medications, or has there been any change in your use of caffeine, alcohol, or other substances?
No, I haven't started any new medications recently. There also haven't been any changes in my use of caffeine, alcohol, or any other substances.
Have you recently experienced or witnessed any extremely frightening or life-threatening events, such as a serious accident, assault, or sudden loss?

Actually, yes, I did experience something extremely frightening about three weeks ago. It was a very stressful and scary situation, but I am still having a really hard time talking about the details of what happened.
I completely understand, and we don't have to go into the details of what happened. Since that event, have you been experiencing unwanted memories, nightmares, or sudden flashbacks about it?

Yes, I have been having very vivid and distressing nightmares about what happened, which constantly wake me up. However, during the day, I don't really experience any sudden flashbacks or unwanted memories while I'm awake.
Have you been actively trying to avoid thinking about the event, or avoiding certain places, people, or activities that remind you of it?
No, I haven't really been actively avoiding thoughts, places, or people related to the event. I haven't noticed myself trying to stay away from anything in particular.
Since the event, have you experienced any feelings of detachment from yourself or your surroundings, as if you are watching things in a dream or daze?

Yes, I have been experiencing those feelings. Sometimes I feel completely detached from my own body, as if I'm an outside observer watching myself. Other times, my surroundings feel totally unreal and dreamlike, like everything around me is distorted.
